title: Parallel library loads never show Reconnect for a healthy provider
acceptance: First: SoundCloud's refresh-token reuse semantics are checked against its docs or a test account and recorded; if refresh tokens are reusable, this task is cancelled or downgraded with that evidence.
Otherwise: the token refresh is a conditional update keyed on the old refresh token; the loser re-reads the row and uses the winner's access token.
The CM-03 repro yields two successes and one provider refresh.
nextAction: Investigate SoundCloud refresh-token reuse before any code. Files if confirmed: apps/api/src/lib/music/ token refresh. Owner-gated paths: the PR needs owner-approved.
